turns.text: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from Shakti Seals? They quote Rs 10.40.
turns.reply:
Gaskets touch food, so specific supplier qualification rules apply.

According to the purchase policy:
"Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked before the first order is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate." (POL-PUR-001 §6.2)

You can purchase from Shakti Seals only if they have a valid food-grade certificate uploaded and verified in Bahi. I cannot see or check Bahi records, so please check Bahi directly to confirm their certification status before placing the order.
